title: SceneTree: Replace manual thread checks with ERR_MAIN_THREAD_GUARD
body:
# PR: SceneTree: Replace manual thread checks with ERR_MAIN_THREAD_GUARD
 
---
 
## Summary
 
This PR completes the migration of `scene_tree.cpp` from ad-hoc
`ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` checks to the
canonical `ERR_MAIN_THREAD_GUARD` / `ERR_MAIN_THREAD_GUARD_V` macros
established in #75901. It also adds guards to two functions that had
**no thread check at all** despite mutating main-thread-only state.
 
No logic is changed. This is a pure consistency and correctness cleanup.
 
---
 
## Motivation
 
PR #75901 introduced `ERR_MAIN_THREAD_GUARD` as the standard way to
enforce main-thread-only access in Godot. The macro:
 
- Is a no-op in release builds (zero runtime cost in shipping games).
- Uses thread-local storage for the check — faster than a raw
  `Thread::is_main_thread()` call.
- Produces a uniform, identifiable error message that tooling and
  contributors can grep for.
- Makes the threading contract of each function self-documenting at
  the call site.
 
`scene_tree.cpp` was only partially updated. Several functions still
used the old pattern, and two were missing guards entirely, meaning
calling them from a worker thread would silently corrupt state in
release builds.
 
---
 
## Changes
 
### Functions migrated from old pattern → ERR_MAIN_THREAD_GUARD
 
| Function | Old check |
|---|---|
| `quit()` | `_THREAD_SAFE_METHOD_` only (mutex, not identity check) |
| `set_pause()` | `ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` |
| `set_suspend()` | `ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` |
| `set_current_scene()` | `ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` |
| `change_scene_to_file()` | `ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` |
| `reload_current_scene()` | `ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` |
| `unload_current_scene()` | `ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` |
| `add_current_scene()` | `ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` |
| `set_multiplayer()` | `ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` |
| `get_multiplayer()` | `ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` |
| `set_multiplayer_poll_enabled()` | `ERR_FAIL_COND_MSG(!Thread::is_main_thread(), ...)` |
 
### Functions with missing guards — newly added
 
| Function | Reason |
|---|---|
| `change_scene_to_packed()` | Mutates `current_scene` and calls `instantiate()` — main-thread only, had no check |
| `change_scene_to_node()` | Mutates `pending_new_scene_id`, `prev_scene_id`, calls `root->remove_child()` — main-thread only, had no check |
 
---
 
## What was NOT changed
 
- All `_THREAD_SAFE_METHOD_` mutex guards are preserved where they
  already exist — they serve a different purpose (protecting data
  accessed from both threads) and are complementary to the identity
  guards, not a replacement.
- No logic, no algorithm, no data structure was modified.
- No new includes or dependencies were added.
 
---
 
## Testing
 
- Confirm that calling any of the above functions from a
  `Thread` or a `PROCESS_THREAD_GROUP_SUB_THREAD` node emits the
  expected error in debug builds and returns early.
- Confirm no regression in normal (main-thread) usage by running the
  existing scene-change and multiplayer test projects.
 
---
 
## Related
 
- #75901 — original `ERR_MAIN_THREAD_GUARD` introduction by reduz


## AI Assisted 
- I have made this pull request with the help of **AI**  . Specifically **Claude** . I have reviewed and edited the code and have performed the necessary checks before making this pull request
